units.source_text: “真一的英语不太好，又害羞，所以只好由我……

en.t: Shinichi's English is not very good, and he is shy too, so I had no choice but to...

units.source_text: 本来这家商店是不需要什么翻译的……

en.t: Actually, this shop does not really need an interpreter...

units.source_text: 何况这些客人在这家商店里只买小型收音机之类东西，

en.t: Besides, these customers only buy things like small radios in this shop,

units.source_text: 她们是住在都酒店里的美国太太。”

en.t: they are American ladies staying at the Miyako Hotel.”
